result.summary: Updates signature encoding test cases in script_tests.json to verify against the DERSIG flag instead of STRICTENC. It also improves test descriptions and adds two error cases to the CHECKMULTISIG NOT test section.
result.problem: Existing signature encoding tests used the STRICTENC policy flag instead of the consensus DERSIG flag, obscuring which checks enforce consensus rules versus standardness policy. Explanatory descriptions and coverage of negative cases in CHECKMULTISIG NOT were also lacking.
evidence: PR description: 'STRICTENC rules are a superset of DERSIG rules, and only DERSIG is a consensus flag.'
